name: regions_stats
description: Region statistics: M4-17 region tests, plasmid replicon-level rows, descriptive prophage subset rows (GIAP_SPEC.md §9.3, §7.3.5(b)).

fields.name: contig
fields.description: Replicon of the row (the tested replicon for split regions)

fields.name: end
fields.description: Region end, 1-based closed; > replicon length for origin-crossing regions (NA for AMR)

fields.name: n_eligible
fields.description: Eligible member genes (not partial, with p_detect)

fields.name: expected
fields.description: Expected detections, sum of p_detect over eligible genes

fields.name: o_over_e
fields.description: Observed over expected detections (NA when expected = 0)

fields.name: hl_shift_log2
fields.description: Hodges-Lehmann shift of log2 abundance (M4-17: residual scale; plasmids: raw log2 against the reference replicons)

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: BH q-value within (region_type, stat); NA without p_value

fields.name: null_model
fields.description: Null model; 'none' implies p_value, q_value NA and n_perm = 0; a q_value implies a p_value

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Number of shifts behind the p-value

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined flags from the controlled vocabulary (§9.4)
